title: FermiViewer project manifest (.fvp v2)
description: Schema for manifest.json inside a .fvp ZIP container. See docs/adr/0002-project-file-format.md. Unknown properties are permitted throughout and MUST be preserved verbatim on save, so a project written by a newer build is not degraded by an older one.

format.description: Magic string; lets a reader reject an unrelated JSON file before anything else.

version.description: Manifest version. v1 was the legacy two-file workspace (.json + .npz) and is read-only legacy.

generation.description: Random hex id for this save. Provenance and torn-write diagnosis; the single-file container makes it non-load-bearing.

saved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the save.

app_version.description: FermiViewer version that wrote the file.

name.description: Human-readable project name; independent of the filename.

payload_mode.description: light: source pixels referenced, derived images embedded. bundle: every image embedded and self-contained.

data_root_hint.description: Absolute path of the data root as seen on the writing machine, forward slashes. A HINT only — resolution falls back to the project file's own directory, then to a user re-point.

primary_param.description: Key into a sample's params naming the independent variable, so result-vs-parameter output and montage ordering need no prompt.

images.description: Every image in the project, in no particular order (ui_state.order governs display).

id.description: Stable id; also the pixels/<id>.npy and thumbs/<id>.png entry name.

axes.description: One AxisCal per data dimension. An axis is calibrated iff scale is finite and non-zero AND units is non-empty.

metadata.description: JSON-safe parser metadata (vendor, beam_kv, content_rows, ...). Non-representable values were dropped at save time.

embedded.description: True iff pixels/<id>.npy exists in this container. Always true for derived images, in BOTH payload modes, because they have no source file.

rel.description: Source path relative to the data root, POSIX separators. Required when embedded is false. Must not be absolute and must not escape the root with '..'.

source.description: Original absolute path at import, kept as provenance only. Never used for resolution.

size_bytes.description: Source file size, for a cheap check that a re-pointed folder holds the expected data.

sha256.description: Optional content hash for strict verification after relocation. Omitted by default — hashing a whole study on every save is not worth the time.

derived_from.description: Parent image id when this image was produced by a filter/crop/analysis rather than read from disk.

unavailable.description: Written true when the previous load could not resolve this image. Advisory: it is re-derived on load, and its presence must never cause the entry to be dropped.

samples.description: Samples and projects. A sample IS an ImageGroup (frontend/src/lib/groups.ts) extended with params and parent; there is no separate grouping mechanism.

image_ids.description: Ordered member ids. MAY contain ids no longer present; readers prune for display and MUST keep them on save. An image id may appear in more than one sample.

parent.description: Parent sample id, giving project -> sample nesting. Null for a root. Cycles are invalid.

params.description: Named experimental parameters for this sample, keyed by parameter name.

value.description: Numeric for anything to be plotted against; string for categorical.

unit.description: Physical unit of value, e.g. degC, nm, sccm. Null for dimensionless or categorical.

color.description: Optional display colour for this sample in sections, panes and plots.

measures.description: Annotations and regions, keyed by image id. Region areas are derived from pts and the image's axis calibration — never stored, so they cannot go stale against a recalibration.

kind.description: polygon and lasso are the closed area kinds; both are measured by one shared area computation.

pts.description: Normalized 0-1 image coordinates, so a measure survives derived images of the same aspect ratio.

holes.description: Enclosed holes subtracted from this region's area (item 19). Each entry is one hole's ring, same normalized 0-1 point-list shape as pts. Absent/empty = no holes.

ui_state.description: Presentational state, deliberately UNVALIDATED beyond being an object: views, display windows, overlay style, savedRois, sbsPanes/sbsRows/sbsCols, browseScale. Passed through verbatim so its shape stays free to change without a format revision.
